display.purpose: Hero H1 only. Calistoga editorial serif — signals craft and establishment, not startup. Fluid via clamp().

headline.purpose: Section H2 titles. Same Calistoga warmth at a smaller fluid range.

title.purpose: H3 card headers, sidebar labels. DM Sans 700 — weight creates hierarchy without a second serif scale.

body.purpose: All paragraph copy. Max line length 680px container (65-75ch). High line-height (1.72) for readability.

body-large.purpose: Hero sub-headlines, lead paragraphs. Slightly larger but same weight — creates a lead paragraph feel.

label.purpose: Tags, stat readouts, price callouts, section eyebrows. The only typographic role that uses letter-spacing.

shadows.name: definition
shadows.purpose: Card resting edge definition. Functions as a border alternative, not decorative depth.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Cards and interactive surfaces on hover. Lifts the element; signals interactivity.

shadows.name: elevated
shadows.purpose: Modals, dropdowns, popovers. Maximum depth in the system.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary CTA button on hover ONLY. One per screen maximum. Never on cards or section backgrounds.

motion.name: entrance
motion.purpose: All element entrances and hover lift animations. Expo-out — fast start, gentle settle.

motion.name: exit
motion.purpose: All exit animations. Duration 60-70% of entrance. Faster exits feel more responsive.

motion.name: color-shift
motion.purpose: Background and text color transitions. Always 150ms.

motion.name: stagger-delay
motion.purpose: Per-item stagger delay for list/grid entrance sequences.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary CTA. Advocate Orange background. Used once per section — its scarcity is the point.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Get a Free Quote <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 8h10M9 4l4 4-4 4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: #E8600A; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 6px; border: none; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #C2500A; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(232, 96, 10, 0.22); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E8600A; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent background with warm border. Warm tint on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: #1C1917; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 6px; border: 1.5px solid #E7E0D8; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease, transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(232, 96, 10, 0.38); background: rgba(232, 96, 10, 0.08); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E8600A; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Tag / Label
components.description: Mono eyebrow label. Advocate Orange foreground on tinted background. Used above headings and on card metadata.
components.html: Built for Small Businesses
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.10em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #E8600A; background: rgba(232, 96, 10, 0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(232, 96, 10, 0.22); border-radius: 100px; padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard content card. Clean Canvas on Morning Parchment. Flat at rest, lifts on hover. Never nested.
components.html:
Service Name

A brief description of what this service delivers and why it matters to the client's business.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1.5px solid #E7E0D8; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.75rem; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.25s ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(232, 96, 10, 0.38); transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(28,25,23,0.10), 0 2px 6px rgba(28,25,23,0.06), 0 0 0 1px rgba(232, 96, 10, 0.22); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1C1917; line-height: 1.3; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; color: #78716C; line-height: 1.72; margin: 0; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Desktop nav link. River Stone at rest, Warm Ink on hover, Advocate Orange when active.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #78716C; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #1C1917; } .ds-nav-link.active { color: #E8600A; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E8600A; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: Mono section eyebrow. Appears above H2 headings to name the section. River Stone for neutral, Advocate Orange for emphasis.
components.css: .ds-section-label { display: block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #E8600A; margin-bottom: 0.875rem; }

narrative.overview:
Lantech serves small businesses that have been burned by agencies — overcharged, underdelivered, treated like an account number. The design system's job is to signal, at a glance, that this is different: a skilled local expert with their act together. Warm, confident, clean — not the cold chrome of enterprise SaaS or the hollow polish of an AI-generated template.

Light mode is mandatory. The background is Morning Parchment (#FAFAF7) — not pure white, not dark. The accent is Advocate Orange (#E8600A): the Rebel signal. It says 'we mean it' without aggression. Calistoga headings carry the editorial warmth of a craftsman's sign, not a startup's growth deck. DM Sans body copy reads like someone who knows their field and speaks plainly.

This system explicitly rejects: dark mode defaults, cyan/purple SaaS palettes, gradient text on headings, glassmorphism, dot-grid textures, ambient glow radial blobs, identical-card feature grids, and the SaaS metric hero row. All are signals of 'AI-generated template' — none belong here.
keyCharacteristics: Light mode only. Warm parchment base. Cold white and dark backgrounds are prohibited.
One accent color. Advocate Orange (#E8600A) on no more than 15% of any given screen. Rarity is the signal.
Editorial serif headings (Calistoga) paired with a humanist sans body (DM Sans). No interchangeable defaults.
Flat surfaces at rest. Shadows are earned by state change (hover, elevation, modal).
At least one anti-grid layout moment per page — asymmetry, overlap, or diagonal flow — to break template symmetry.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Advocate Orange is used on no more than 15% of any given screen. CTAs and active states only. If orange appears everywhere, it means nothing.

rules.name: The No-Cold-Shadow Rule
rules.body: All shadow values use rgba(28, 25, 23, ...) — warm ink at low alpha. rgba(0, 0, 0, ...) is prohibited in all shadow declarations.

rules.name: The Calistoga-Only Rule
rules.body: Calistoga is the sole heading font. Inter, Space Grotesk, Unbounded, Poppins, Plus Jakarta Sans, and Roboto are prohibited as heading fonts.

rules.name: The No-Body-Tracking Rule
rules.body: Letter-spacing on DM Sans body copy is forbidden. Tracking (0.10em) is permitted only on JetBrains Mono label elements.

rules.name: The Italic-as-Voice Rule
rules.body: Calistoga italic is the only emphasis voice permitted in headings. Body copy uses DM Sans 600 weight for inline emphasis — never italic.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: No surface renders decorative shadow at rest. Real elevation is earned by interaction state only.

rules.name: The Earned Glow Rule
rules.body: Accent Glow (rgba(232, 96, 10, 0.22)) is permitted on one element per screen: the primary CTA button hover state. It is not a decorative pattern for cards, sections, or secondary buttons.

dos: Do use #FAFAF7 (Morning Parchment) as the page background — the warm off-white is the system's base signal.
Do use Calistoga for all H1 and H2 headings — the editorial serif is the primary brand differentiator.
Do use Advocate Orange (#E8600A) sparingly: primary CTAs, active nav states, tags, focus rings only.
Do use warm shadows exclusively: rgba(28, 25, 23, ...) at maximum 0.12 alpha.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest — shadows and lifts are earned by hover state only.
Do include at least one anti-grid layout moment per page: asymmetric columns, overlap, diagonal flow, or a grid-breaking element.
Do specify hover + focus-visible + active states on every interactive element.
Do animate transform and opacity only — no layout property animations.
Do use transition: [property] [duration] [easing] — named properties always, never transition-all.
Do cap body text containers at 680px max-width (65–75 characters per line).
Do use prefers-reduced-motion to disable all non-essential transitions.
Do use the entrance easing cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for hover lifts and element entrances.
donts: Don't use dark mode as default. The site is light mode. This is non-negotiable.
Don't use cyan (#00E5FF) or purple (#7C5CFC) — these are the eradicated old brand colors.
Don't use gradient text via background-clip: text on headings. Prohibited.
Don't add dot-grid texture backgrounds. Prohibited.
Don't add ambient glow radial gradients (the cyan/purple blob glows). Prohibited.
Don't use glassmorphism — blurred translucent cards or glass-border effects. Prohibited.
Don't use Inter, Roboto, Arial, Space Grotesk, Unbounded, Plus Jakarta Sans, or Poppins as a heading font.
Don't use transition-all — always specify individual transition properties.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing — cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, ...) is banned.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, padding, margin).
Don't nest cards — no card inside a card.
Don't use identical-card feature grids — vary card sizes, weights, or layout rhythm.
Don't use a colored left-border or right-border stripe as a card emphasis pattern.
Don't build a SaaS metric hero row ('50+ businesses · 48h · 100%') — use contextual social proof instead.
Don't use cold black shadows (rgba(0,0,0,...)). Warm ink tints only.
Don't use pure white (#FFFFFF) as the page background — Morning Parchment (#FAFAF7) only.
